name: Ling 3.0 Flash Sante
description: Ling 3.0 Flash Sante is Inclusion AI's health and medicine enhanced 124B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with approximately 5.1B active parameters per token. It is designed for medical knowledge reasoning, clinical safety, evidence-based retrieval, and long-horizon medical tasks while retaining general reasoning, coding, and agentic capabilities.
